verified.max_results: docs: https://docs.parallel.ai/api-reference/search-api/search (advanced_settings.max_results); live on /v1beta through tests/test_integration_surface.py::test_max_results_is_an_upper_bound, not yet re-run on /v1
verified.search_depth: docs: https://docs.parallel.ai/api-reference/search-api/search (advanced_settings.excerpt_settings.max_chars_per_result, an upper bound per URL); not yet run live
verified.exclude_domains: docs: https://docs.parallel.ai/api-reference/search-api/search (advanced_settings.source_policy.exclude_domains, ignored when include_domains is set); not yet run live
verified.country: docs: https://docs.parallel.ai/search/advanced-search-settings (advanced_settings.location, one of 37 listed codes; any other is ignored, so web-router refuses it); not yet run live
verified.recency: docs: https://docs.parallel.ai/api-reference/search-api/search (advanced_settings.source_policy.after_date, YYYY-MM-DD); not yet run live
verified.effort: docs: https://docs.parallel.ai/search/modes (turbo, fast, basic, advanced); not yet run live

max_chars_total.note: Top level: an upper bound on excerpt characters across all results.

fetch_policy.note: Under advanced_settings: max_age_seconds (600 or more), timeout_seconds, disable_cache_fallback. Cached content unless set.

client_model.note: The model consuming the results; Parallel tailors default settings to it.

session_id.note: Groups related search and extract calls, up to 1,000 characters; the response echoes it, or one the server made.

excerpts.note: Beta only; /v1/search rejects undeclared fields. Its successors are max_chars_total and advanced_settings.excerpt_settings.

max_chars_per_result.note: Beta only, deprecated there; on /v1 it sits under advanced_settings.excerpt_settings.

processor.note: Beta only, deprecated there in favour of mode.
